faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands?

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands, and when is it waived?

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands?

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Crystal Clear Transparent. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands completes in 4–7 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Clear Acrylic Challenge Coin Capsules & Display Stands can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
